title: Prajna Paramita Retreat 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher invites participants to explore the concept of emptiness as a fundamental aspect of reality that can lead to liberation and happiness. Emptiness is not about escaping the world, but rather about developing a relationship with it and finding freedom from suffering. By studying texts like the Prajnaparamita Sutra and practicing mindfulness, participants can cultivate an understanding of emptiness that allows them to appreciate its presence in every moment.
